<tbody><tr>
<td class="MainPageBG" style="width:50%;border:1px solid #cedff2;background-color:#f5faff;vertical-align:top">
<table cellpadding="2" cellspacing="5" style="vertical-align:top;background-color:#ffffff" width="100%">
<tbody><tr>
<th> <h2 style="margin:0;background-color:#cef2e0;font-family:sans-serif;font-size:120%;font-weight:bold;border:1px solid #a3bfb1;text-align:left;color:#000;padding:0.2em 0.4em;"><span class="mw-headline" id=".40en.7COWASP_Overview.0A_.40es.7CIntroducci.C3.B3n_a_OWASP"></span></h2>
</th></tr>
<tr>
<td style="color:#000;align:center">Every vibrant technology marketplace needs an unbiased source of information on best practices as well as an active body advocating open standards. In the Application Security space, one of those groups is the Open Web Application Security Project™ (or OWASP for short).
<p>The Open Web Application Security Project (OWASP) is a <a class="external text" href="https://www.irs.gov/charities-non-profits/charitable-organizations/exemption-requirements-section-501c3-organizations" rel="nofollow">501(c)(3)</a> worldwide not-for-profit charitable organization focused on improving the security of software. Our mission is to make software security <a class="external text" href="https://www.owasp.org/index.php/Category:OWASP_Video" rel="nofollow">visible,</a> so that <a class="external text" href="https://www.owasp.org/index.php/Industry:Citations" rel="nofollow">individuals and organizations</a> are able to make informed decisions.  OWASP is in a unique position to provide impartial, practical information about AppSec to individuals, corporations, universities, government agencies, and other organizations worldwide. Operating as a community of like-minded professionals, OWASP issues software tools and knowledge-based documentation on application security.
</p><p>Everyone is free to participate in OWASP and <u>all of our materials</u> are available under a free and open software license.  You'll find everything <b><a class="mw-redirect" href="/index.php/About_OWASP" title="About OWASP">about OWASP</a></b> here on or linked from our wiki and current information on our <a class="external text" href="http://owasp.blogspot.com" rel="nofollow">OWASP Blog</a>. OWASP <b>does not endorse or recommend commercial products or services</b>, allowing our community to remain vendor neutral with the collective wisdom of the best minds in software security worldwide.  
</p><p>We ask that the community look out for <a class="external text" href="https://www.owasp.org/index.php?title=OWASP_brand_usage_rules" rel="nofollow">inappropriate</a> uses of the OWASP brand including use of our name, logos, project names, and other trademark issues.   
</p><p>There are thousands of <a class="external text" href="https://www.owasp.org/index.php?title=Special:ActiveUsers&amp;limit=500" rel="nofollow">active wiki users</a> around the globe who review the changes to the site to help ensure quality. If you're new, you may want to check out our <b><a href="/index.php/Getting_Started" title="Getting Started">getting started</a></b> page. As a global group of volunteers with over 45,000 participants, questions or comments should be sent to one of our many <b><a class="external text" href="https://lists.owasp.org/mailman/listinfo" rel="nofollow">mailing lists</a></b> focused on a topic or directed to the staff using the <b> <a class="external text" href="https://owasporg.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/7/group/18/create/72" rel="nofollow">OWASP Contact Us Form</a>. </b> <br/>
</p>
<center><b><a class="external text" href="https://www.owasp.org/index.php/Category:OWASP_Project" rel="nofollow">Pick an OWASP Project</a>  -  <a class="external text" href="https://www.owasp.org/index.php/Category:OWASP_Chapter#Joining_your_local_chapter" rel="nofollow">Find Your Local OWASP Chapter</a></b> </center>
</td></tr>
<tr>
<th> <h2 style="margin:0;background:#cef2e0;font-family:sans-serif;font-size:120%;font-weight:bold;border:1px solid #a3bfb1;text-align:left;color:#000;padding:0.2em 0.4em;"><span class="mw-headline" id=".40en.7COWASP_Community.0A_.40es.7CComunidad_OWASP"></span></h2>
</th></tr>
<tr>
<td style="color:#000">
<h2><span class="mw-headline" id="Flagship_Projects">Flagship Projects</span></h2>
<h4><span class="mw-headline" id="Projects_that_have_demonstrated_strategic_value_to_OWASP_and_application_security_as_a_whole">Projects that have demonstrated strategic value to OWASP and application security as a whole</span></h4>
<div style="margin:auto;">
<div style="display:inline-block;width:100%;text-align:center;border:0px;padding:0px;border-bottom:1px solid #000;border-top:1px solid #000;">
<div style="font-weight:bold;background:lightblue;">Tool Projects</div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;background:transparent;">
<div><a href="/index.php/OWASP_Zed_Attack_Proxy_Project" title="OWASP Zed Attack Proxy Project">OWASP Zed Attack Proxy (ZAP)</a></div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;">
<div>Automatically finds security vulnerabilities in your web applications while you are developing and testing your applications</div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;background:lightgray;">
<div><a href="/index.php/OWASP_Web_Testing_Environment_Project" title="OWASP Web Testing Environment Project">OWASP Web Testing Environment (WTE)</a></div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;background:lightgray;">
<div>A collection of easy-to-use application security tools and documentation available in multiple formats</div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;">
<div><a href="/index.php/OWASP_OWTF" title="OWASP OWTF">OWASP OWTF</a></div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;">
<div>Pentesting tool to more efficiently find, verify and combine vulnerabilities in short timeframes</div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;background:lightgray;">
<div><a href="/index.php/OWASP_Dependency_Check" title="OWASP Dependency Check">OWASP Dependency Check</a></div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;background:lightgray;">
<div>A utility that identifies project dependencies and checks if there are any known, publicly disclosed, vulnerabilities</div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;">
<div><a href="/index.php/OWASP_Security_Shepherd" title="OWASP Security Shepherd">OWASP Security Shephard</a></div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;">
<div>A web and mobile application security training platform to foster and improve security awareness among a varied skill-set demographic</div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;background:lightgray;">
<div><a href="/index.php/OWASP_DefectDojo_Project" title="OWASP DefectDojo Project">OWASP DefectDojo</a></div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;background:lightgray;">
<div>An open source vulnerability management tool that streamlines the testing process by offering templating, report generation, metrics, and baseline self-service tools</div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;">
<div><a href="/index.php/OWASP_Juice_Shop_Project" title="OWASP Juice Shop Project">OWASP Juice Shop</a></div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;">
<div>An intentionally insecure webapp for security trainings written entirely in JavaScript which encompasses the entire OWASP Top Ten and other severe security flaws</div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;background:lightgray;">
<div><a href="/index.php/OWASP_Security_Knowledge_Framework" title="OWASP Security Knowledge Framework">OWASP Security Knowledge Framework</a></div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;background:lightgray;">
<div>A tool that is used as a guide for building and verifying secure software that can also be used to train developers about application security</div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;">
<div><a href="/index.php/OWASP_Dependency_Track_Project" title="OWASP Dependency Track Project">OWASP Dependency Track</a></div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;">
<div>A Software Composition Analysis (SCA) platform that keeps track of all third-party components used in all the applications an organization creates or consumes. It monitors all applications in its portfolio in order to proactively identify vulnerabilities in components that are placing your applications at risk</div>
</div>
<div style="display:inline-block;width:100%;text-align:center;border:0px;padding:0px;border-bottom:1px solid #000;border-top:1px solid #000;">
<div style="font-weight:bold;background:lightblue;">Code Projects</div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;">
<div><a href="/index.php/Category:OWASP_ModSecurity_Core_Rule_Set_Project" title="Category:OWASP ModSecurity Core Rule Set Project"> OWASP ModSecurity Core Rule Set (CRS)</a></div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;">
<div>A set of generic attack detection rules for use with ModSecurity or compatible web application firewalls which aims to protect web applications from a wide range of attacks</div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;background:lightgray;">
<div><a href="/index.php/Category:OWASP_CSRFGuard_Project" title="Category:OWASP CSRFGuard Project">OWASP CSRFGuard</a></div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;background:lightgray;">
<div>A library that implements a variant of the synchronizer token pattern to mitigate the risk of Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attacks</div>
</div>
<div style="display:inline-block;width:100%;text-align:center;border:0px;padding:0px;border-bottom:1px solid #000;border-top:1px solid #000;">
<div style="font-weight:bold;background:lightblue;">Documentation Projects</div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;">
<div><a href="/index.php/Category:OWASP_Application_Security_Verification_Standard_Project" title="Category:OWASP Application Security Verification Standard Project"> OWASP Application Security Verification Standard</a></div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;">
<div>Provides a basis for testing web application technical security controls and also provides developers with a list of requirements for secure development</div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;background:lightgray;">
<div><a href="/index.php/OWASP_AppSensor_Project" title="OWASP AppSensor Project">OWASP AppSensor</a></div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;background:lightgray;">
<div>A conceptual framework and methodology that offers prescriptive guidance to implement intrusion detection and automated response into applications</div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;">
<div><a href="/index.php/OWASP_SAMM_Project" title="OWASP SAMM Project"> OWASP Software Assurance Maturity Model (SAMM)</a></div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;">
<div>An open framework to help organizations formulate and implement a strategy for software security that is tailored to the specific risks facing the organization</div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;background:lightgray;">
<div><a href="/index.php/Category:OWASP_Top_Ten_Project" title="Category:OWASP Top Ten Project"> OWASP Top Ten</a></div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;background:lightgray;">
<div>A powerful awareness document for web application security that represents a broad consensus about the most critical security risks to web applications</div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;">
<div><a href="/index.php/OWASP_Testing_Project" title="OWASP Testing Project">OWASP Testing Guide</a></div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;">
<div>Includes a "best practice" penetration testing framework which users can implement in their own organizations and a "low level" penetration testing guide that describes techniques for testing most common web application and web service security issues</div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;background:lightgray;">
<div><a href="/index.php/OWASP_Cheat_Sheet_Series" title="OWASP Cheat Sheet Series">OWASP Cheat Sheet Series</a></div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;background:lightgray;">
<div>The OWASP Cheat Sheet Series was created to provide a concise collection of high value information on specific application security topics. These cheat sheets were created by various application security professionals who have expertise in specific topics.</div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;">
<div><a href="/index.php/OWASP_Mobile_Security_Testing_Guide" title="OWASP Mobile Security Testing Guide">OWASP Mobile Security Testing Guide</a></div>
</div>
<div style="width:50%;text-align:left;padding:0px;margin:0px;float:left;">
<div>A security standard for mobile apps and a comprehensive testing guide that covers the processes, techniques, and tools used during a mobile app security test, as well as an exhaustive set of test cases that enables testers to deliver consistent and complete results.</div>
</div>
</div>
</td></tr>
<tr>
<th> <h2 style="margin:0;background:#cef2e0;font-family:sans-serif;font-size:120%;font-weight:bold;border:1px solid #a3bfb1;text-align:left;color:#000;padding:0.2em 0.4em;"><span class="mw-headline" id=".40en.7COWASP_Community.0A_.40es.7CComunidad_OWASP_2"></span></h2>
</th></tr>
<tr>
<td style="color:#000">
<div class="center"><div class="floatnone"><a href="/index.php/Acknowledgements" title="Acknowledgements"><img alt="Thank-you-word-cloud-1024x791.jpg" height="216" src="/images/thumb/d/d9/Thank-you-word-cloud-1024x791.jpg/400px-Thank-you-word-cloud-1024x791.jpg" srcset="/images/thumb/d/d9/Thank-you-word-cloud-1024x791.jpg/600px-Thank-you-word-cloud-1024x791.jpg 1.5x, /images/thumb/d/d9/Thank-you-word-cloud-1024x791.jpg/800px-Thank-you-word-cloud-1024x791.jpg 2x" width="400"/></a></div></div>
<p><b>Thank you </b> to our our corporate supporters that enable us to make software security visible, so that individuals and organizations worldwide can make informed decisions about true software security risks.  A complete list of our current corporate and academic supporters can be found on our <a class="external text" href="https://www.owasp.org/index.php/Acknowledgements" rel="nofollow">Acknowledgements Page</a>
</p><p><br/>
<br/>
</p><p><br/>
</p>
</td></tr>
<tr>
<th> <h2 style="margin:0;background:#cef2e0;font-family:sans-serif;font-size:120%;font-weight:bold;border:1px solid #a3bfb1;text-align:left;color:#000;padding:0.2em 0.4em;"><span class="mw-headline" id=".40en.7COWASP_Community.0A_.40es.7CComunidad_OWASP_3"></span></h2>
</th></tr>
